chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Sayyari, from Ahmad ibn al-Fadl, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from al-Rida (peace be upon him)
Regarding the Jalal fish, he asked him about it, so he said: 'It is awaited for a day and a night.' And al-Sayyari said: 'This does not occur except in Basra.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the Jalal fish according to Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (AS) establishes the ruling for the 'Jalal' fish, requiring a waiting period of a day and a night, which Shia jurists interpret as necessary to purify its flesh from the taste of excrement due to its diet. Al-Sayyari’s geographical note linking this condition to Basra highlights the practical application of this ruling in regions known for specific aquatic environments, reflecting the Shi'a emphasis on contextualizing fiqh with local conditions.
